high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a vibrant red background that transitions into a gradient of orange and yellow on the right side. The individual is dressed in a stylish outfit consisting of a light gray blazer with a subtle checkered pattern and matching pants. Underneath the blazer, there appears to be a colorful, draped garment in shades of purple, yellow, and green, adding a pop of color to the otherwise neutral-toned ensemble. The person has shoulder-length, wavy hair that cascades over their shoulders. They are wearing a pair of earrings that complement their attire.
